tensor_roles.vla_raw_output: Normalized or raw 55-D model output; not executable.
tensor_roles.selected_active_channels: Masked/sliced Panda-relevant dims after channel selection.
tensor_roles.denormalized_target: Absolute EE xyz+xyzw + gripper_cmd (scheme B) in physical units.
tensor_roles.bounded_command: Incremental or rate-limited command for the existing control stack; not equal to denormalized_target.
tensor_roles.measured_state: Simulator feedback joints/ee/gripper; ground for open-loop logs and continuous GT only.

notes: Design-only. Must not be used to authorize Gate V1/V2/V3 execution.
